source.prompt: (the barred owl's) A barred owl (Strix varia), one adult perched upright, side-on pose, wings folded against the body. Realistic proportions: 50 cm long, a big round head with NO ear tufts, a pale grey-brown facial disc with concentric dark rings, large dark brown eyes, a small yellow hooked bill, a stocky body, a medium tail. Grey-brown plumage with white bars across the back and wings, horizontal brown bars across the upper breast and vertical brown streaks on the pale belly; feathered legs and feet with dark talons. No base, no perch, no branch. Game-ready, clean closed mesh.

tiers.note: A variant of the barred owl's Meshy preview (no credits), scaled to 0.22 m tall, the head widened 1.05x (the barred owl's 1.15); two short ear tufts (four-sided horns, 1.5 cm) set into the crown at the top corners of the facial disc; yellow eyes with black pupils as forward discs; a small grey-black bill cone; feathered pale legs with dark talons; a 7 cm rounded tail barred pale (lod0), angled 34 degrees below level (raised from 55 to keep its tip off the ground). Colours: grey upperparts streaked black and finely cross-barred (face bands, lod0 and lod1); a grey facial disc with fine rings, pale brows running into the tufts and a dark rim; pale grey underparts streaked black and cross-barred; a row of white scapular spots along the top of the folded wing (whole faces); grey barred flight cards. Triangles: lod0 1,199 = 792 body + 407 legs, tail, cards, eyes and bill; lod1 449 = 306 body + 143 legs, tail, cards, eyes and bill; lod2 140 = 86 body + 54 legs, tail, cards, eyes and bill. GLB 245,964 bytes. lod_m is a suggestion.

rig: bird rig template of the Steller's jay (tools/build_stellersjay.py; drawn with client/src/animalModels.js RIG.stjay's constants): PART BODY 0, LEG_A 1 / LEG_B 2 procedural legs (pivot at the knee), TAIL 3 procedural tail (pivot at the rump), HEAD 6 (head and neck, pivot at the base of the neck), WING_L/R 4/5 and HAND_L/R 9/10 flight cards that collapse into the shoulder on pose; extras.rig {kind 'bird', wing (shoulder), tail (rump), head (neck base), length_m}; no skin
accuracy_notes: Built 2026-11-05. Reads as a small grey eared owl: tufts, yellow eyes, dark-rimmed grey face, bark-grey streaked plumage. Still open: the streaks and cross-bars are per-face colour on ~800 body faces, so they read as mottling rather than fine bark pattern; the scapular spots are two or three large faces, not a neat row; the barred owl's body is a little long for this compact owl; the upright model flies 'standing up' under RIG.stjay unless the client pitches it (as the barred owl).
